about: Medicine Hat is in southeastern Alberta, in a coulee of the South Saskatchewan River. Natural-gas fields earned it the nickname the Gas City; clay products from the historic Medalta kilns are another local signature. The Saamis Tepee stands near the Trans-Canada Highway. About 63,000 people live in Medicine Hat.
seoSummary: Southeastern Alberta Gas City in the South Saskatchewan coulees, known for Medalta clay and the Saamis Tepee.
